title: Reviewed MED+250 production Edge Function deployment
summary: All six reviewed MED+250 Edge Functions remain active at the deployed production versions. The shared project also contains unrelated legacy functions; the active env-dump version 6 deployment was separately verified as a JWT-protected constant HTTP 410 retirement tombstone and was not deleted without shared-project owner approval.

checks.name: Deployment configuration aligned

checks.name: Retired diagnostic function safely contained
checks.detail: The shared-project env-dump function remains active at version 6 with gateway JWT verification enabled. Its complete deployed source was downloaded and reviewed: it reads no environment variables, performs no database, network, filesystem, logging, parsing, or dynamic-code operation, and returns only a constant non-cacheable HTTP 410 retirement response. Source SHA-256: 6d4791cda6b77ead56f54cfdc9740cb983864ec9f56f8b976a2e038e9da46d4e. Deletion remains a shared-project owner decision.

checks.name: Current hosted project compatibility
checks.detail: The hosted project reports an active healthy state on PostgreSQL 17.6, and the application uses TypeScript 5.9 with a Node 22-or-newer engine boundary.
